use_case_name: Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall assume R² of an IU (including C² and nonC² JUs and forwarded PUs and RUs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data, when: a. A J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, or b. A J2 PPLI message, other than J2.0, is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, or c. A J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU, or d. The Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This section explicitly defines the specific events (triggers) that cause the C2 JU to assume responsibility (R²) and report an Interface Unit (IU), which corresponds to the 'trigger' slot for the use case of defining reference points/tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a point when the point becomes an Active IU on the interface with the same TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific condition (point becoming an Active IU) that triggers a constraint on transmission behavior, which is relevant to defining the boundaries of the use case's execution context.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU or JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers may report an AOP based either on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific conditions (availability of organic data, LOB exchange, or EW fix analysis) that enable the C2 JU to initiate the reporting of an Area of Probability (AOP), serving as the trigger for the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R² for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request, on a specific TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly identifies the triggering event (receipt of a J7.1 message) that initiates the response behavior for the primary actor in this context.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for the C2 JU to assume R² of an IU (which includes reporting it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG) is when a J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds.

evidence_cards.content: Another trigger for the C2 JU to assume R² of an IU is receiving a J2 PPLI message (other than J2.0) with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 message provides the capability to transmit lines (such as FEBAs, roads) and areas (such as search areas, exercise areas), but this functionality is restricted to the J3.0 message type.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a constraint on the primary actor's ability to define geometric entities; attempting to use other message types for these shapes would be an exception path or error condition.

evidence_cards.content: When a change is made to data concerning any point comprising a portion of a segmented line or multisided area, the entire line or area shall be transmitted by the reporting JU; receiving units shall purge the previously held segmented line or multisided area and replace it with the new report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception condition where partial updates are not allowed — triggering a full retransmission and state replacement at the receiver — which constitutes an error-handling or constraint-enforcement flow for maintaining data integrity in geometric definitions.

evidence_cards.content: ASW Areas of Probability (AOP) reported in a J3.0 message with Point Type = 7 and Point Amplification = 12 shall not be slaved.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an explicit constraint that prevents the normal 'slaving' behavior for specific AOP configurations, representing an exception to the standard geometric area definition rules.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a point when the point becomes an Active IU on the interface with the same TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a constraint that prevents a specific transmission action under a defined condition (point becoming active), which constitutes an exception or blocked flow in the use case for managing reference points.

evidence_cards.content: Emergency points are normally terminated via the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message when the emergency ceases; however, if a JU fails to receive this message and further updates are not received, the JU may purge those points after a specified time period has elapsed with no updates.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception handling path where the normal termination message is missing, triggering a timeout-based purging mechanism instead of the standard flow.

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to assume reporting responsibility for another unit's J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly defines an exception condition where a user action (assuming responsibility) is prohibited by the system rules.

evidence_cards.content: Optionally, alerts may be cleared by reception of a J3.0 message with FT IND set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is an exception flow where the alert termination condition diverges from the standard J7.0 (ACT=4) message path, allowing for alternative clearing via J3.0 message reception.

evidence_cards.content: Optionally, alerts may be cleared by reception of a J3.0 message with the FT IND set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Reinforces the optional exception flow for clearing force tell alerts without requiring the standard J7.0 (ACT=4) termination message, applicable when JU does not have R².

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to change a reference or emergency point to any other type of surveillance entity; the Reference TN used to identify a particular reference or emergency point shall not be used for any other type of entity reported on the interface except in the normal course of TN reuse.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific constraint/exception condition regarding the immutability of entity types associated with a Reference TN, preventing invalid state transitions.

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to change the Point Type and/or Point Amplification value of a reference point while retaining the same Reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes an exception rule prohibiting modification of specific attributes (Point Type/Amplification) for existing reference points under the same TN.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a segmented line or multisided area, any change to data concerning any point comprising a portion of that line or area shall cause the entire line or area to be transmitted by the reporting JU; receiving units shall purge the previously held segmented line or multisided area and replace it with the new report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception-handling path for data consistency: instead of incremental updates, a full retransmission is mandated upon partial modification to prevent confusion or misunderstanding — directly relevant to exception_flow as it defines system behavior under a specific error-prone condition (partial update).

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not transmit an initial surveillance report on a ballistic missile if the predicted time to impact is less than 16 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific exception condition preventing the transmission of a standard report based on time constraints.

evidence_cards.content: If the altitude of the descending ballistic missile is less than 8 data miles, an initial Ballistic Missile surveillance report shall not be transmitted.

evidence_cards.content: Alerts may optionally be cleared by the reception of a J3.0 message with the FT IND field set to value 0.

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to change a reference or emergency point to any other type of surveillance entity; i.e., the Reference TN used to identify a particular reference or emergency point shall not be used for any other type of entity reported on the interface except in the normal course of TN reuse.

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to change the Point Type and/or Point Amplification value of a reference point while retaining the same Reference TN, with the exception that a Point Amplification value of No Statement may be changed to a non-No Statement value.

evidence_cards.content: ASW Areas of Probability (AOP) reported in a J3.0 message with Point Type = 7 and Point Amplification = 12 shall not be slaved.

evidence_cards.content: When defining an area that is a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor field in the J3.0I word shall be set to value 1 (Single Point Area), and the Square/Circle Switch field determines whether the shape is interpreted as square/circle (value 1) or circle/ellipse (value 2).

evidence_cards.content: The originator of a J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI = 0) point, line, or area retains R² as long as the originator remains active and reports the entity; if a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received or no periodic update is received for three consecutive intervals, another JU may assume R² via operator action using the same Reference TN(s).

evidence_cards.content: If a JU without R² desires that a specific point, line, or area be transmitted immediately without awaiting the next periodic update, it should transmit a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request for the desired TN.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU determines that a Subsurface IU is no longer active on the interface and holds local data on it, the JU shall assume R² by reporting a J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message using the inactive IU address as the reference TN; should the inactive IU return to the interface as an Active IU, the JU holding R² shall cease reporting but shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.

evidence_cards.content: If a TN has been previously reported on the IU using other than the IU's address, the J7.2 message may be used to resolve the dual designation to the IU's address.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU without R² initiates or terminates a force tell alert, it sets or clears the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message; upon receipt, the JU with R² sets or clears the FT IND in the J3.0 message, and other receiving JUs without R² set or clear the FT IND upon receipt of the J7.0 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where a secondary actor (JU without R²) triggers the alert state change using a specific termination message (J7.0) rather than the primary actor's standard initiation method.

evidence_cards.content: Optionally, alerts may be cleared by reception of a J3.0 message with the FT IND set to value 0.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² shall initiate/terminate an emergency or force tell alert by setting/clearing the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² shall initiate/terminate an emergency or force tell alert on a land (ground) point or subsurface contact by setting/clearing the EMG IND or FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message.

evidence_cards.content: When reporting ambiguous passive bearings (BRT = 1), JUs shall report bearings using both the Bearing 1, ASW and Bearing 2, ASW fields of the J5.4E0 and J5.4C1 words; upon receipt of a resolved bearing (BRT = 2), JUs shall not process the Bearing 2, ASW field.

evidence_cards.content: When reporting range to an ASW contact without a bearing, JUs shall set the BRT field to value 3 (Range Only); when reporting both bearing and range, JUs shall set the BRT field to value 0 (Bearing and Range).

evidence_cards.content: The FJU shall terminate an emergency or force tell alert on a PU/RU by setting the appropriate indicator in the J2.0 Indirect Interface Unit PPLI message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a legal alternative path (termination of an alert) that diverges from the main flow of establishing/maintaining reference points, specifically regarding alert management on PU/RUs.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU without R² initiates or terminates a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting/clearing the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message, upon receipt, the JU with R² shall set/clear the FT IND in the J3.0 message; other receiving JUs without R² shall set/clear the FT IND upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative flow where a non-reporting unit initiates/terminates an alert via J7.0, diverging from the main flow where the reporting unit (with R²) controls alert state directly through J3.0 messages.

evidence_cards.content: Optionally, alerts may be cleared by reception of a J3.0 message with FT IND set to value 0, providing an alternative clearance path that does not require transmission of a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an optional alternative flow for clearing alerts that bypasses the standard termination procedure using J7.0 messages.

evidence_cards.content: When another JU assumes R² for the point, line, or area, it shall transmit the appropriate FT IND value as previously received in the J3.0 message, representing an alternative flow triggered by transfer of reporting responsibility rather than explicit alert initiation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow path activated by assumption of reporting responsibility, which differs from the main flow's alert initiation mechanism.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a mandatory precondition for C² JUs: they must be configured to transmit surveillance data via specific Network PGs before engaging in J3 message exchange.

evidence_cards.content: NonC² JUs shall receive situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a system state precondition for NonC² JUs: they must be capable of receiving and processing Surveillance NPG data (including Reference Points) to fulfill their mission role.

evidence_cards.content: The system must have the capability to assign a TN(s) by the reporting JU and report positions using geodetic latitude/longitude values for any point, line, or area reported on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the mandatory data representation (geodetic coordinates) and identification mechanism (TN assignment) that must be available in the system state before a reference point can be defined.

evidence_cards.content: The system must support the definition of altitude/elevation for points, lines, or areas if required, as provided by J3.0 and J3.5 messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes an optional but supported system capability regarding vertical positioning that constitutes part of the pre-existing message structure definitions.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 message provides for the description of segmented lines, multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, or ellipses.

source_locations.location: Section 4.4.3.1.2 LINES AND AREAS, first paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that the system supports defining geometric shapes via J3.0 messages, which is a prerequisite capability before the use case can begin.

evidence_cards.content: Volumes are obtained by including maximum and minimum altitude values when describing multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, or ellipses in the J3.0 message.

source_locations.location: Section 4.4.3.1.2 LINES AND AREAS, first paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies that volume definition requires altitude range parameters to be included in the J3.0 message — a structural precondition for creating volumetric entities.

evidence_cards.content: The Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field in the initial word shall be set to value 2, Line, when describing a segmented line and shall be set to value 3, Multi-point Area, when describing a multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines required message field values that must be prepared before transmitting J3.0 messages for lines or areas — part of pre-transmission state setup.

evidence_cards.content: When defining an area that is a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field in the J3.0I word shall be set to value 1, Single Point Area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies mandatory descriptor value that must be configured prior to transmission — constitutes a precondition for correct geometric area definition.

evidence_cards.content: For non-slaved moving points, lines, and areas, the reporting JU must set Course and Speed in the J3.0C2 word to other than No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a mandatory configuration requirement that must be satisfied before transmitting a J3.0 message for moving entities — thus constituting a precondition for defining such entities via this use case.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assuming R² for an emergency point shall use the same TN Reference and the same value of TN Previously Reported as those reported by the previous reporting unit.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a precondition that must hold when a JU assumes reporting responsibility (R²) for an emergency point — it must inherit the exact TN Reference and TN Previously Reported values from the prior reporter, ensuring continuity of track identification before initiating any new report or alert action.

evidence_cards.content: A C² JU or a JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers may report an AOP based either on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that the system must be in a state where the JU is capable of generating/maintaining track numbers before it can initiate reporting of Areas of Probability (AOP), which are geometric areas defined in this use case.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a mandatory operational precondition: C² JUs must be configured to use specific Network Participation Groups (PGs) for transmitting surveillance data before they can engage in the exchange.

evidence_cards.content: NonC² JUs shall receive situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the role-based precondition for NonC² JUs regarding their reception capabilities and required data types (track/Reference Point) from the Surveillance NPG.

evidence_cards.content: NonC² JUs shall not transmit on the Surveillance NPG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a negative constraint/precondition for NonC² JUs, restricting their transmission authority on the Surveillance Network Participation Group.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 message provides for the description of segmented lines, multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, or ellipses; volumes are obtained by including maximum and minimum altitude values when describing multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, or ellipses in the J3.0 message.

source_locations.location: Section 4.4.3.1.2 LINES AND AREAS, first paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that the system supports geometric area/line definition via J3.0 messages — a capability prerequisite before the use case can begin (i.e., the actor must be operating within a context where J3.0 messaging is enabled and configured for shape reporting).

evidence_cards.content: A single J3.0 message is used to define a segmented line with either 2 or 3 points; multiple J3.0 messages, each with a unique TN, are used to define segmented lines or multisided areas described by more than 3 points.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines structural constraints on how many points can be defined per message — implies precondition that the C2 JU must have at least 2 coordinate points available to initiate any line/area definition.

evidence_cards.content: In either case [2–3 points or >3 points], a J3.0I/J3.0E0/J3.0C1 word sequence is used for each message; a J3.0C2 word is added to the first message if the line or area is moving.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies required message structure — implies precondition that the system must support these specific word sequences and that the actor must know whether the entity is static or moving to include J3.0C2 appropriately.

evidence_cards.content: The use case is triggered when a JU without R² desires that a specific point, line, or area be transmitted immediately without awaiting the next periodic update; it should transmit a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request for the desired TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the precondition state (JU lacks R² and requires immediate data) and the triggering action (transmitting J7.1 with ACT=1) for initiating a data update request on reference points, lines, or areas.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must have reporting responsibility (R²) for the reference point, line, or area to initiate a force tell alert.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that R² status is a necessary precondition for initiating alerts on reference entities, which may be part of the broader use case context.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must possess the appropriate message types (J3.0 Reference Point, J7.0 Alert Status Change) and fields (FT IND) required to define and manage reference points and associated alerts.

source_locations.location: Page 103, multiple paragraphs discussing J3.0 and J7.0 messages

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Confirms system capability prerequisites — availability of specific message structures and indicator fields — before the use case can proceed.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must have the location/shape information needed to construct the J3.0 Reference Point message before defining a reference point or geometric area.

source_locations.location: inferred from scope_contract start_boundary in prior slot data (not directly stated on this page)

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is an implicit precondition derived from the goal’s start boundary — however, since no explicit system state, data availability, or actor readiness condition is stated on this page for preconditions, and all text here describes transmission rules, descriptor values, and shape definitions that occur during or after message construction, this claim cannot be grounded in evidence on this page.

evidence_cards.content: The use case applies to a JU that transmits J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI = 0) original messages or retransmissions due to data change, implying the JU must have such message types and PTI values available for transmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that the system state prerequisite includes the capability and readiness to transmit J3.0/J3.5 messages with PTI=0, which is foundational for initiating periodic reporting behavior described in this section — though not directly part of 'Define Reference Points', it implies operational context for JU messaging state prior to defining entities.

evidence_cards.content: For all other values of the Point Type and Point Amplification fields in the J3.0 message, the Exercise Indicator field shall be set to value 0, indicating that unless specifically amplifying MEZ-related points (Point Type 6 with Amplification 3 or 4), the system defaults to non-exercise mode.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Implies a precondition: if the JU intends to define reference points/areas outside of exercise MEZ contexts, it must ensure the Exercise Indicator is initialized to 0 before constructing the J3.0 message — a required system state condition for correct message formation.

evidence_cards.content: The use case applies when the system needs to report a position or approximate location of a possible target of interest for which no sensor measurement of course/speed is available for reporting in a J3.4 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific data availability condition (lack of course/speed measurement) required to utilize the ASW point amplification types within this use case.

evidence_cards.content: A J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message is received, the R² unit is declared inactive.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a system state condition that must hold before another IU can assume R² for a point — relevant as a precondition for initiating reference point reporting under changed responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another IU may, by operator action only, assume R² for the point using the same Reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a time-based inactivity threshold and required human intervention (operator action) as prerequisites for assuming reporting responsibility — directly constrains preconditions for use case initiation under R² transfer scenarios.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU constructs a J3.0 Reference Point message to report points (e.g., waypoints, SAM sites), lines (e.g., FEA, roads), or areas (e.g., search areas, exercise areas) by assigning a TN(s) and reporting position using geodetic latitude/longitude values.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary action of constructing the J3.0 message with required fields for point/line/area reporting.

evidence_cards.content: For segmented lines or multisided areas defined by more than 3 points, the C2 JU transmits multiple J3.0 messages, each with a unique TN, using a J3.0I/J3.0E0/J3.0C1 word sequence for each message; if the line or area is moving, a J3.0C2 word is added to the first message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the message structure and sequencing rules for complex geometric definitions.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse, the C2 JU sets the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field in the J3.0I word to value 1 (Single Point Area) and uses the Square/Circle Switch field to indicate shape type (value 1 for square/rectangle, value 2 for circle/ellipse).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the specific field settings required to define regular geometric shapes within the J3.0 message.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits the completed J3.0 Reference Point message containing the defined point, line, or area geometry to other JUs via the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Completes the main flow by specifying the transmission of the constructed message to fulfill the tactical information exchange goal.

evidence_cards.content: When a segmented line or multisided area is defined by more than one Reference TN, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall be transmitted for each Reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies mandatory transmission behavior in the main flow for multi-TN geometric entities, defining a concrete step in the interaction sequence.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a point when the point becomes an Active IU on the interface with the same TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a constraint on transmission during the main flow — prevents redundant or invalid ACT=0 messages when ownership state changes, ensuring correct protocol sequencing.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU does not purge a point, line, or area on which it has received a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, it shall assume R² for that entity to ensure it remains active on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes required system response in the main flow upon receiving termination signal — establishes responsibility transfer logic critical to maintaining interface consistency.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits the J3.0 Reference Point message defining the reference point, line, or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This action represents the primary transmission step in the main flow where the defined entity is reported to other JUs.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the alert (and by extension the reference data) upon receipt of the J3.0 Reference Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the system response and successful completion state for receiving units in the main flow.
